# KET CoC Generator

> Official Queensland Electrical Safety Regulation 2026 Certificate of Testing & Compliance (CoC / CoT / CoTC) Generator. Built by Kai Electrical Tech Pty Ltd.

- Official Application: https://tools.kaielectrical.com.au
- Organization: Kai Electrical Tech Pty Ltd (https://kaielectrical.com.au)
- License: Open Source (MIT)
- Regulatory Standard: Queensland Electrical Safety Regulation 2026 (s229 Installation / s208 Equipment) & ESO Form V7.09-2026

## Primary Features
- 100% Free & Watermark-Free: Zero subscriptions, zero paywalls, completely clean official certificates.
- Device-Level Privacy: Zero cloud databases, zero server transmission. All contractor credentials and client data remain strictly inside client localStorage.
- Anti-Tamper Rasterization: Flattens certificates into high-resolution non-editable image PDFs stamped with a unique physical Device ID.
- Embedded Searchable OCR Text Layer: Invisible full-text indexing layer allows Windows Search, macOS Spotlight, Google Drive, and Adobe Acrobat to search and copy client, job, and certificate details.
- Dynamic Multi-Page Annexure A: Automatically appends formatted continuation sheets whenever electrical work descriptions exceed Page 1 capacity.
- Offline-Ready PWA: Full Service Worker caching and native Web Share API support for seamless use on remote job sites without mobile reception.
